fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: You run down an enemy at or below 25% health from up to 6 tiles away and drive it into the dirt, dealing 24 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Den-Shaking Bark
fusions.desc: You bark into the ground ahead, dealing 25 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead; if it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Cache
fusions.desc: You bury a cache of jagged stone under the nearest enemy. For 30 seconds, the first 2 times an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it, it bursts for 18 damage.

fusions.name: Cairn Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound of packed earth fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
